description: Source code for Lua's Memory Manager interface, including memory allocation, reallocation, deallocation, and handling of memory limits and errors.

methods.name: luaM_growaux_
methods.description: Grows or reallocates an array during parsing, ensuring capacity without exceeding limits.

methods.name: luaM_shrinkvector_
methods.description: Shrinks an array to a specified size, used for memory optimization.

methods.name: luaM_toobig
methods.description: Handles memory allocation errors when a block is too large.

methods.name: luaM_free_
methods.description: Frees a memory block and updates garbage collector debt.

methods.name: luaM_realloc_
methods.description: Reallocates memory with emergency collection fallback.

methods.name: luaM_saferealloc_
methods.description: Safely reallocates memory, raising an error if allocation fails.

methods.name: luaM_malloc_
methods.description: Allocates memory with tracking and error handling.
